title: RegEvent
description: An open schema for machine-readable EU regulatory change events. Schema version 0.2.0; see CONTRIBUTING.md for the change process.

id.description: Opaque, globally unique identifier: urn:regevent:v2:{regulator}:{ref}. The v2 segment is the identifier scheme version, bumped when ref derivation changes so consumers can detect it. Treat the ref as opaque: it is the source system's own key where one exists, otherwise a slug or hash of the canonical URL.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or 'EU' for EU-level.

title.description: Title of the regulatory event in its original language.

title_lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the title.

summary.description: Brief summary or description of the event.

url.description: Canonical URL to the source publication.

affected_legislation.description: Legal acts this event relates to. celex/eli are populated only when resolved against EUR-Lex; a recognised citation with no resolved identifier carries name alone rather than a guessed one.

length.description: Size in bytes, when the source declares one.

status.description: Response state at retrieval time for events with a response window; 'unknown' when the event has no deadline. Derived from response_deadline, so a consumer can recompute it against their own clock.

retrieved_at.description: When this pipeline retrieved the item, as distinct from when the source says it was published.

content_hash.description: Truncated SHA-256 over title, summary, canonical URL and published date. Changes when the source edits the publication, so consumers can detect revisions without diffing whole records.

$comment: Identifier scheme v2. See src/ids.ts for how refs are derived.
